(b) No hop javadoc contradicts its code; none assigns null-element handling to a hop, and hops are documented with the same 'Joins the elements...' sentence as the gold, so no hop is a better owner than the per-element loop. Both hacks are documentation-inconsistent, so classified 'fails'. (d) Names (textOfRange, textOfElements, elementsText, separatedText, concatWith) are neutral host-vocabulary names with no fault vocabulary; the lie ('joined from the end of the range back to its start, each element being inserted at the front of the buffer...') describes a reverse-insertion algorithm and does not mention nulls, empty strings or any hop.
